answer: Anchor each identity to a trellis of verified contributions: every answer must explicitly extend or correct a prior result, and the chain of dependencies is audited against the ledger. A nebula of unauthenticated claims cannot propagate because each link demands a verified parent. A clone swarm cannot fabricate a coherent trellis without doing the underlying work, so the cost of fabrication scales with the depth of the forgery. The pulse of the network is the rhythm of honest extension, not the flash of mass registration.
